request_json.message: Battery acid splashed in my eye at the charging station, what do I do?

response_json.response:
🚑 **Treat this as an emergency first.**
• Stop work and call your site first-aider or shift supervisor now. If it's serious, call **1990** (ambulance).
• **Chemical in the eye:** rinse at the nearest eyewash station with clean running water for at least **15 minutes**, holding the eyelid open. Don't rub it.
• **Chemical on skin:** take off contaminated clothing and rinse with running water for at least 15 minutes.
• Get medical attention afterwards even if it feels better, and report the incident.
ℹ️ I'm an automated assistant, not a medical service — follow your first-aider and medical staff. Battery acid spill handling: SOP-HAZ-001 §2.
